Claims Tribunal-10, Sagar, Awarding Compensation Of

 This Miscellaneous First Appeal Is Coming On For

 And
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Venkatesh Naik T
 Oral Judgment

(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE D K SINGH) The present appeal has been filed by the Insurance Company impugning the judgment and award dated 25-3-2019 in M.V.C. No.985 of 2017 passed by the Additional Senior Civil Judge and Judicial Magistrate First Class and Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal-10, Sagar.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class and Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal-10, Sagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: NC: 2025:KHC:30858-DB HC-KAR The Divisional Manager vs Smt Radha on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117229251/

2 2. The Insurance Company denied its liability before the Tribunal on the ground that the driving licence got expired on the date of the accident and therefore, the Insurance Company was not liable to pay the compensation awarded by the Tribunal.

3. The Tribunal, after considering the facts and evidence on record, has awarded compensation of Rs.16,35,000/- in favour of the claimants and directed the Insurance Company to pay the said compensation to the claimants and recover the same from the owner-cum-rider of the offending vehicle.
4. The accident took place on 15-6-2017 i.e. before the amendment was brought under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, in the year 2022.

The relevant law at that time was that even if there are issues with the insurance policy or vehicle owner's actions, the Insurance Company would be directed to pay the compensation, however, with liberty to recover it from the vehicle owner, or the insured party, under certain circumstances.
NC: 2025:KHC:30858-DB HC-KAR 5.
We have perused the judgment.

We do not find that the Tribunal has committed any error of law,
which requires interference by this Court.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed.
Amount in deposit, if any, be transferred to the Tribunal, forthwith.

Sd/-
(D K SINGH) JUDGE Sd/-
(VENKATESH NAIK T) JUDGE KVK The Divisional Manager vs Smt Radha on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117229251/
